name: Total Population
description: De facto total population in a country, territory or jurisdiction at mid-year.
methodology: UN World Population Prospects cohort-component demographic estimation and census reconciliation.

name: Population Density
description: Mid-year population divided by total land area in square kilometers.
methodology: Ratio of total resident population to national sovereign land area excluding inland water bodies.

name: Median Age
description: The age that divides the population into two numerically equal halves.
methodology: Calculated from interpolated single-year demographic age distributions.

name: Sex Ratio (Male per 100 Female)
description: Number of males per 100 females in the total de facto population.
methodology: National civil registration records and census sex composition tables.

name: Fertility Rate (TFR)
description: Average number of live children that would be born to a woman during her reproductive lifetime.
methodology: Total Fertility Rate based on cumulative age-specific birth rates.

name: Crude Death Rate
description: Annual number of deaths per 1,000 mid-year population.
methodology: Vital statistics registration adjusted for demographic completeness.

name: Life Expectancy at Birth
description: Average projected number of years a newborn infant would live under prevailing mortality patterns.
methodology: Standard life table survival probabilities applied to age-specific mortality rates.

name: Net Migration Rate
description: Annual net total of international immigrants minus emigrants per 1,000 people.
methodology: Derived as demographic residual between natural increase and intercensal growth.

name: Urban Population Share
description: Proportion of national population residing in areas designated as urban.
methodology: Aggregated national municipal boundaries and satellite settlement density modeling.

name: Annual Population Growth Rate
description: Exponential rate of annual population change over the reporting period.
methodology: Annualized log difference between consecutive mid-year population estimates.

name: Average Household Size
description: Average number of co-resident family and domestic members sharing living quarters.
methodology: Census household enumerations and Demographic and Health Surveys (DHS).

name: Annual Net Population Addition
description: Net annual numerical increase or decrease in sovereign population count.
methodology: Absolute demographic addition: births minus deaths plus net cross-border migration.

name: Nominal Gross Domestic Product
description: Total market value of all final goods and services produced within a country converted at market exchange rates.
methodology: System of National Accounts (SNA 2008) converted via annual official exchange rates.

name: GDP Per Capita
description: Gross domestic product divided by mid-year total population.
methodology: Nominal GDP in current US dollars divided by UN DESA population estimate.

name: Consumer Price Inflation
description: Annual percentage change in the cost to the average consumer of acquiring a basket of goods and services.
methodology: Laspeyres consumer price index (CPI) series over 12 calendar months.

name: Exchange Rate to USD
description: National currency units per one United States Dollar.
methodology: Annual period average market exchange rate reported by national monetary authorities.

name: Government Revenue Share
description: Total central and general government revenues including taxes and transfers as a percentage of GDP.
methodology: Government Finance Statistics Manual (GFSM 2014) accounting framework.

name: General Government Gross Debt
description: Total outstanding gross liabilities of general government as a share of nominal GDP.
methodology: Includes domestic and external debt securities, loans, currency and deposits at nominal face value.

name: Trade Openness Ratio
description: Sum of exports and imports of goods and services measured as a share of GDP.
methodology: Balance of Payments (BPM6) customs declarations and national accounts expenditure data.

name: FDI Net Inflows
description: Foreign direct investment net inflows to the reporting economy as a percentage of GDP.
methodology: Direct investment equity flows, reinvested earnings, and intra-company loans exceeding 10% voting equity.

name: Central Bank Policy Interest Rate
sourceName: Bank for Int. Settlements / Central Banks
description: Benchmark short-term policy interest rate set by the sovereign central monetary authority.
methodology: Stated headline refinancing, overnight repo, or key discount facility rate.

name: Stock Market Capitalization
description: Total share price value of all domestic publicly listed companies divided by GDP.
methodology: Aggregate end-of-year market capitalization of domestic equities on national exchanges.

name: Income Gini Coefficient
description: Measure of the deviation of the distribution of income among individuals or households from a perfectly equal distribution.
methodology: Lorenz curve integration where 0 represents absolute equality and 100 represents absolute inequality.

name: Total Foreign Reserves (incl. Gold)
description: External assets readily available to and controlled by monetary authorities for direct financing of payments imbalances.
methodology: Monetary gold, special drawing rights (SDRs), reserve position in IMF, and foreign exchange currency reserves.

name: PM2.5 Air Pollution Exposure
description: Population-weighted annual mean concentration of fine particulate matter with a diameter under 2.5 micrometers.
methodology: Aerosol optical depth satellite monitoring combined with chemical transport modeling and ground stations.

name: Renewable Internal Freshwater
description: Total internal renewable freshwater resources including river flows and groundwater from rainfall per resident.
methodology: Hydrological water balance accounting internal surface runoff and groundwater recharge.

name: Safely Managed Drinking Water
description: Proportion of population using drinking water from an improved source located on premises, available when needed, and free of contamination.
methodology: Household surveys and sanitary water utility compliance monitoring.

name: Forest Area Coverage
description: Land spanning more than 0.5 hectares with trees higher than 5 meters and a canopy cover of more than 10 percent.
methodology: National forest inventories calibrated with Landsat/Sentinel satellite multispectral canopy tracking.

name: Red List Biodiversity Index
description: Index evaluating aggregate extinction risk trends across national mammal, bird, amphibian, and coral species.
methodology: Weighted tracking of species threat categories (Extinct to Least Concern) where 1 indicates zero extinction risk.

name: Key Biodiversity Areas Protected
description: Mean percentage of Key Biodiversity Areas that are covered by formal protected area designation.
methodology: Geospatial intersection of official national park polygons and confirmed global KBA coordinates.

name: Degraded Land Share
description: Proportion of land that is degraded over total land area under SDG indicator 15.3.1.
methodology: Composite evaluation of land productivity dynamics, land cover change, and soil organic carbon stocks.

name: Municipal Waste Recycling Rate
sourceName: World Bank What a Waste / UNEP
description: Percentage of total generated municipal solid waste that is collected and processed through material recycling or composting.
methodology: Municipal waste stream characterization and authorized recycling facility weight manifests.

name: Marine Protected Areas Coverage
sourceName: UNEP-WCMC World Database on Protected Areas
description: Share of territorial seas and exclusive economic zones designated as protected marine reserves.
methodology: Maritime boundaries GIS vector analysis against gazetted marine conservation legal perimeters.

name: Natural Resource Depletion Rate
description: Sum of net forest depletion, energy depletion (coal, oil, gas), and mineral depletion as a share of Gross National Income.
methodology: Resource rent calculation: physical extraction volumes multiplied by world market prices minus production costs.

name: Terrestrial Protected Land Area
description: Proportion of total national terrestrial land area formally protected under IUCN Categories I-VI.
methodology: Cartographic verification of gazetted national parks, wilderness sanctuaries, and nature reserves.

name: Carbon Emissions Per Capita
description: Total territorial greenhouse carbon dioxide emissions from fossil fuel burning and industrial cement production divided by population.
methodology: Energy consumption fuel accounting multiplied by IPCC oxidation and emissions conversion factors.

name: Healthy Life Expectancy (HALE)
description: Average number of years that a person can expect to live in full health, taking into account years lived in less than full health due to disease or injury.
methodology: Sullivan life table method weighting age-specific mortality by Global Burden of Disease disability prevalence.

name: Under-5 Child Mortality Rate
sourceName: UN Inter-agency Group for Child Mortality Estimation (UN IGME)
description: Probability of a child dying between birth and exactly 5 years of age expressed per 1,000 live births.
methodology: Bayesian B-spline bias-adjusted regression model of civil registration, vital statistics and demographic surveys.

name: Maternal Mortality Ratio
description: Annual number of female deaths from any cause related to or aggravated by pregnancy or its management per 100,000 live births.
methodology: Multilevel regression model of pregnancy-related mortality adjusted for misclassification and underreporting.

name: Premature NCD Mortality Probability
description: Probability of dying between the exact ages of 30 and 70 from cardiovascular disease, cancer, diabetes, or chronic respiratory disease.
methodology: Standardized cause-of-death vital registration modeling adjusted for demographic age structures.

name: Cardiovascular Death Rate
sourceName: WHO GHO / IHME Global Burden of Disease
description: Age-standardized annual mortality rate from ischemic heart disease and cerebrovascular stroke.
methodology: Direct age-standardization against the WHO World Standard Population.

name: Hospital Bed Density
description: Total inpatient hospital beds available in public, private, general, and specialized medical institutions.
methodology: Ministry of Health licensing registries and national hospital census audits.

name: Physician Density
description: Number of fully registered medical doctors actively practicing medicine in the national health system per 1,000 residents.
methodology: National professional licensing boards and national human resources for health observatories.

name: Current Health Expenditure
description: Total level of current healthcare expenditure expressed as a percentage of gross domestic product.
methodology: System of Health Accounts (SHA 2011) covering public spending, private insurance, and household out-of-pocket payments.

name: DPT3 Vaccine Coverage Rate
description: Percentage of children aged 12-23 months who have received three doses of the diphtheria, pertussis, and tetanus vaccine.
methodology: WHO/UNICEF Estimates of National Immunization Coverage (WUENIC) based on administrative provider records and surveys.

name: Prevalence of Undernourishment
description: Estimate of the proportion of the population whose habitual food consumption is insufficient to provide dietary energy requirements.
methodology: Parametric log-normal distribution modeling of dietary energy consumption, coefficient of variation, and minimum energy requirements.

name: Age-Standardized Suicide Rate
description: Annual suicide mortality rate per 100,000 population, age-standardized to the WHO World Standard Population.
methodology: Civil registration and vital statistics (CRVS) mortality data with ill-defined death redistribution.

name: Safely Managed Sanitation Services
description: Proportion of population using improved sanitation facilities that are not shared and where excreta are safely disposed of in situ or treated.
methodology: Household survey regression and wastewater utility effluent treatment compliance.

name: Adult Literacy Rate
description: Percentage of the population aged 15 years and over who can both read and write with understanding a short simple statement.
methodology: National population censuses, labor force surveys, and UNESCO Global Age-specific Literacy Projections (GALP).

name: Primary Education Completion Rate
description: Gross intake ratio to the last grade of primary education expressed as a percentage of the population at the entrance age for the last grade.
methodology: Total number of new entrants in the last grade of primary divided by target population cohort.

name: Net Secondary School Enrollment
description: Total enrollment of the official secondary school-age population divided by total population in that age group.
methodology: Annual school census reports matched with UN DESA single-year population projections.

name: Gross Tertiary Enrollment Ratio
description: Total enrollment in tertiary education (ISCED levels 5-8) regardless of age expressed as a percentage of the 5-year age cohort following high school.
methodology: Higher education registry student counts divided by official post-secondary population cohort.

name: Government Education Expenditure
description: General government expenditure on education (current and capital) expressed as a percentage of GDP.
methodology: National budget execution reports classified by functional educational expenditures.

name: Primary Pupil-Teacher Ratio
description: Average number of primary school pupils per teacher in educational institutions.
methodology: Headcount of enrolled primary school pupils divided by full-time equivalent primary instructional staff.

name: Secondary Gender Parity Index
description: Ratio of the female gross enrollment ratio to the male gross enrollment ratio in secondary education.
methodology: Quotient of female secondary GER divided by male secondary GER where 1.0 indicates perfect gender balance.

name: Schools with Electricity Access
description: Percentage of primary educational facilities with regular access to an electrical power source for pedagogical use.
methodology: School census infrastructure audit verified by national educational management information systems (EMIS).

name: PISA Standardized Reading Score
sourceName: OECD Programme for International Student Assessment (PISA 2022/2024)
description: Standardized reading literacy assessment score achieved by 15-year-old secondary students.
methodology: Item Response Theory (IRT) calibrated to an OECD mean score of 500 points with standard deviation of 100.

name: Vocational Secondary Enrollment Share
description: Percentage of all students enrolled in upper secondary education who are enrolled in technical or vocational tracks.
methodology: Enrolled students in technical-vocational tracks divided by total upper-secondary enrollment.

name: STEM Tertiary Graduate Share
sourceName: UNESCO UIS / OECD Education at a Glance
description: Percentage of all tertiary education graduates who earned degrees in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM).
methodology: ISCED Fields of Education classifications (Natural sciences, mathematics, statistics, ICT, and engineering).

name: Primary Out-of-School Children Rate
description: Proportion of children of official primary school age who are not enrolled in pre-primary, primary, or secondary school.
methodology: Difference between target population cohort and verified institutional administrative school enrollments.

name: Internet Penetration Rate
description: Percentage of individuals who used the internet from any location via any device within the last 3 months.
methodology: National household surveys on ICT access and usage compiled by the International Telecommunication Union.

name: Mobile Cellular Subscriptions
description: Number of active mobile cellular phone subscriptions with access to the public switched network.
methodology: Regulatory filings from telecommunication operators divided by mid-year population multiplied by 100.

name: Fixed Broadband Subscriptions
description: Subscriptions to high-speed public internet connections at downstream speeds of at least 256 kbit/s (DSL, cable, FTTH).
methodology: Telecommunications regulatory authority data collection covering commercial, residential, and corporate accounts.

name: 5G Population Coverage
description: Percentage of the sovereign population living within outdoor radio propagation coverage of a commercial 5G cellular network.
methodology: Carrier radio frequency coverage maps intersected with high-resolution satellite population density grids.

name: Government AI Readiness Index
description: Composite index evaluating national government capability to implement Artificial Intelligence across public services.
methodology: Multi-pillar assessment covering government vision, technology sector capacity, data infrastructure, and digital ethics.

name: Global Cybersecurity Index (GCI)
description: Composite index measuring country commitment to cybersecurity across legal, technical, organizational, capacity, and cooperation pillars.
methodology: 5-pillar survey verified against national CERT capabilities, cybercrime statutes, and incident response frameworks.

name: UN E-Government Development Index
description: Composite index benchmarking national readiness and capacity of public institutions to use ICT for delivering public services.
methodology: Weighted average of Online Service Index (OSI), Telecommunication Infrastructure Index (TII), and Human Capital Index (HCI).

name: Global Innovation Index (GII)
description: World standard metric measuring national innovation performance, ecosystem inputs, and technological knowledge outputs.
methodology: 80 indicators spanning institutions, human capital, infrastructure, market sophistication, business sophistication, knowledge, and creative outputs.

name: Total Patent Applications
description: Worldwide patent applications filed by national residents and non-residents directly or through the Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT).
methodology: National intellectual property registry annual filing manifests audited by the World Intellectual Property Organization.

name: R&D Expenditure (% of GDP)
description: Gross domestic expenditure on scientific research and experimental development (GERD) expressed as a share of GDP.
methodology: Frascati Manual (OECD 2015) standardized surveys covering business enterprise, government, higher education, and private non-profit R&D.

name: Industrial Robot Density
description: Number of operational multi-axis industrial robots per 10,000 employees in the manufacturing industry.
methodology: Annual industrial robot shipment invoices and national manufacturing employment censuses.

name: High-Technology Exports Share
description: Products with high R&D intensity (aerospace, computers, pharmaceuticals, scientific instruments, electrical machinery) as a share of manufactured exports.
methodology: SITC Rev. 4 commodity classifications matched to OECD R&D intensity thresholds.

name: Annual Defense Budget
description: Total government spending on military forces, defense ministries, intelligence operations, arms procurement, and military personnel.
methodology: NATO and UN standard military expenditure definitions converted to current US dollars at official market exchange rates.

name: Active Duty Military Personnel
description: Total uniformed military personnel on active full-time service in armed forces branches.
methodology: Verified annual order-of-battle counts from defense ministries and parliamentary committee reports.

name: Main Battle Tanks Inventory
description: Number of operational and active-reserve tracked main battle tanks (MBTs) deployed in national ground army formations.
methodology: Standardized counting of armored combat vehicles mounting high-caliber direct fire main guns.

name: Military Combat Aircraft
description: Total air force and naval inventory of active operational fighter, strike, and dedicated ground attack aircraft.
methodology: Annual defense fleet inventory audits excluding unarmed training and secondary liaison transports.

name: Total Naval Fleet Assets
description: Aggregate count of all naval combatants including aircraft carriers, destroyers, frigates, corvettes, submarines, and patrol craft.
methodology: Commissioned surface warships and active submarines documented on official naval registers.

name: Estimated Nuclear Warhead Stockpile
description: Total estimated sovereign inventory of deployed and stockpiled military nuclear warheads.
methodology: Federation of American Scientists (FAS) and SIPRI intelligence cross-checks of nuclear fissile materials and delivery platforms.

name: Major Conventional Arms Exports
description: Volume of international deliveries of major conventional weapons exported, measured in SIPRI Trend Indicator Values (TIV).
methodology: TIV system measuring the volume of military resources transferred rather than financial transaction contracts.

name: Major Conventional Arms Imports
description: Volume of major conventional arms and weapons platforms delivered to the importing country.
methodology: SIPRI Trend Indicator Values (TIV) calculated from observed delivery manifests and transfer agreements.

name: Military Expenditure (% of GDP)
description: Total annual military expenditure expressed as a percentage of gross domestic product.
methodology: Military spending divided by nominal GDP under the System of National Accounts.

name: Formal Mutual Defense Alliances
description: Number of active ratified multilateral and bilateral mutual defense assistance pacts.
methodology: Formal treaties deposited with the United Nations containing explicit mutual defense casus foederis clauses.

name: Annual Conflict Battle Deaths
description: Total direct combat fatalities recorded from state-based armed conflicts, non-state conflicts, and one-sided violence.
methodology: Event-based conflict tracking cross-verified by independent humanitarian, academic, and journalistic observers.

name: Global Military Strength Index
description: Comprehensive score utilizing over 60 individual military, financial, logistical, and geographical factors.
methodology: Formula weighting conventional weapons diversity, available manpower, logistical freedom, and defense budget.

name: Human Development Index (HDI)
description: Summary measure of average achievement in key dimensions of human development: a long and healthy life, being knowledgeable, and have a decent standard of living.
methodology: Geometric mean of normalized indices for life expectancy, expected/mean years of schooling, and GNI per capita (PPP).

name: World Happiness Score
description: National average life evaluation score based on the Cantril Ladder survey question where 10 is the best possible life.
methodology: Nationally representative Gallup World Poll samples with 3-year rolling averages.

name: Global Peace Index (GPI)
description: The world's leading measure of global peacefulness evaluating societal safety, ongoing domestic/international conflict, and militarisation.
methodology: 23 qualitative and quantitative indicators weighted by an international panel of peace experts.

name: Corruption Perceptions Index (CPI)
description: The most widely used global corruption ranking assessing perceived public sector corruption by experts and business executives.
methodology: Standardization of 13 independent data sources from 12 independent institutions onto a 0 (highly corrupt) to 100 (very clean) scale.

name: Global Innovation Index
description: Annual ranking of the innovation capabilities and results of world economies.
methodology: Average of Innovation Input Sub-Index (5 pillars) and Innovation Output Sub-Index (2 pillars).

name: EIU Democracy Index
description: Snapshot of the state of democracy across electoral processes, civil liberties, functioning of government, political participation, and political culture.
methodology: 60 indicators grouped across five categories classifying regimes: Full Democracy, Flawed Democracy, Hybrid Regime, Authoritarian.

name: World Press Freedom Index
description: Evaluation of the state of journalism and freedom of the press in 180 countries and territories.
methodology: Structural quantitative survey of abuses against journalists combined with expert qualitative questionnaire across 5 contexts: political, legal, economic, sociocultural, and security.

name: Global Gender Gap Index
description: Benchmarking index measuring gender parity across four key dimensions: Economic Participation, Educational Attainment, Health and Survival, and Political Empowerment.
methodology: Ratio-based metric where 1.0 indicates complete parity between women and men without penalizing female advantage.

name: Index of Economic Freedom
description: Annual guide measuring the principles of economic freedom: rule of law, government size, regulatory efficiency, and open markets.
methodology: 12 quantitative and qualitative factors graded on a 0 to 100 scale.

name: Passport Mobility Score
description: Total number of global destinations their holders can access without obtaining a prior visa.
methodology: Official data from the International Air Transport Association (IATA) verified through ongoing research.

name: Quality of Life Index
description: Empirical estimation of overall quality of life based on purchasing power, safety, healthcare, climate, cost of living, and pollution.
methodology: Formula weighting purchasing power (+), safety (+), health care (+), climate (+), traffic commute (-), pollution (-), and house price to income (-).

name: WJP Rule of Law Index
description: Leading source for original, independent data on the rule of law across 8 primary factors: constraints on government powers, absence of corruption, open government, fundamental rights, order and security, regulatory enforcement, civil justice, and criminal justice.
methodology: Household surveys and legal expert questionnaires standardized on a 0 to 1 scale.

name: Environmental Performance Index (EPI)
sourceName: Yale Center for Environmental Law & Policy 2024
description: Global metric ranking countries on climate change performance, environmental health, and ecosystem vitality.
methodology: 40 performance indicators across 11 issue categories gauging national progress toward established environmental policy targets.

name: World Competitiveness Ranking
description: Benchmark analyzing economies based on how they manage their competencies to achieve long-term value creation.
methodology: Assessment of 336 competitiveness criteria grouped into four factors: Economic Performance, Government Efficiency, Business Efficiency, and Infrastructure.

name: Total Sovereign Land Area
description: Total aggregate land area enclosed within internationally recognized sovereign boundaries.
methodology: Geodetic cadastral surveys excluding permanent inland lakes and major rivers.

name: Capital City Population
description: Total resident population residing in the designated national capital city metropolitan jurisdiction.
methodology: Official municipal census counts and UN DESA metropolitan agglomeration boundaries.

name: Total Land Area (Sq Miles)
description: National sovereign land surface area expressed in square miles.
methodology: Direct geometric conversion (1 km² = 0.386102 sq miles) of verified sovereign land area.

name: Inland Water Area Share
description: Percentage of total sovereign territory occupied by inland water bodies (lakes, reservoirs, rivers).
methodology: Hydrographic boundary surveys divided by total surface area.

name: Coastline Length
description: Total perimeter length of oceanic and open-sea continental and island coastlines.
methodology: High-resolution digital fractal boundary measurement at 1:250,000 scale.

name: Total Land Boundary Length
description: Total contiguous length of shared sovereign terrestrial borders with neighboring states.
methodology: Bilateral boundary demarcation treaties deposited with the United Nations.

name: Highest Elevation Point
description: Maximum vertical elevation above mean sea level found within national territory.
methodology: Satellite radar topography (SRTM) and high-precision trigonometric benchmarks.

name: Longest National River Length
description: Total course length of the longest river traversing or originating in the country.
methodology: Digital hydrological flow-routing analysis of global river network datasets.

name: Largest Inland Lake Surface Area
description: Surface area of the largest permanent natural freshwater or saline lake within national borders.
methodology: Satellite multispectral surface water extent mapping.

name: Recognized Island Count
description: Total number of permanently exposed subaerial marine islands and islets belonging to national territory.
methodology: Hydrographic survey registries at high-water datum.

name: Arid and Hyper-Arid Land Share
description: Proportion of national territory classified as arid, semi-arid, or hyper-arid drylands.
methodology: UNEP Aridity Index ratio of mean annual precipitation to potential evapotranspiration (P/PET < 0.65).

name: Total Forested Land Area
description: Total absolute land area covered by primary, naturally regenerating, or planted forest canopies.
methodology: FRA national reporting confirmed by Sentinel-2 remote sensing canopy classification.

name: Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ) Area
description: Area of sovereign maritime waters extending up to 200 nautical miles from baseline under UNCLOS.
methodology: Standardized sovereign maritime boundary polygons calculated from territorial basepoints.

name: Mean Terrain Elevation
sourceName: NOAA NCEI ETOPO Global Relief Model
description: Average elevation of national terrestrial land surface above global mean sea level.
methodology: Area-weighted spatial average of digital surface elevation cells across sovereign polygon.

name: International Tourist Arrivals
description: Total number of overnight international non-resident visitor arrivals at national borders.
methodology: Border immigration passport control tallies and national accommodation guest registration audits.

name: International Tourism Receipts
description: Expenditures by international inbound visitors on goods and services in the destination country, including transport.
methodology: Balance of Payments (IMF BPM6) travel credit accounts in current US dollars.

name: Outbound International Tourism Spending
description: Total expenditures incurred by resident travelers outside their country of origin on international trips.
methodology: Balance of Payments travel debit records collected through commercial banking transactions and surveys.

name: Tourism Intensity Ratio
description: Ratio of international visitor arrivals relative to resident population.
methodology: Annual inbound overnight tourist arrivals divided by national mid-year population.

name: Commercial Hotel Bed-Places
description: Total capacity of licensed tourist accommodation establishments in guest rooms.
methodology: National ministry of tourism registry audits and commercial hospitality inventory tracking.

name: Air Transport Passengers Carried
description: Total commercial scheduled air passengers carried by air carriers registered in the country.
methodology: ICAO commercial airline monthly traffic reports summing domestic and international flight legs.

name: UNESCO World Heritage Properties
description: Number of cultural, natural, and mixed properties inscribed on the official UNESCO World Heritage List.
methodology: Official statutory committee inscriptions under the 1972 World Heritage Convention.

name: Designated Biosphere & Ecotourism Reserves
description: Number of UNESCO Man and the Biosphere reserves and national ecotourism sanctuaries.
methodology: Designated ecological conservation territories promoting sustainable tourism development.

name: Annual Museum & Heritage Attendances
description: Total recorded annual attendances at public and national museums, archaeological parks, and art institutions.
methodology: Official ticketing audits compiled by national cultural ministries.

name: Travel & Tourism GDP Contribution
description: Total economic contribution of travel and tourism including direct, indirect, and induced impacts as a share of GDP.
methodology: Tourism Satellite Account (TSA) macroeconomic modeling standard.

name: Travel & Tourism Development Index
description: Comprehensive benchmark evaluating factors enabling the sustainable development of the travel and tourism sector.
methodology: 112 indicators across 17 pillars covering business environment, safety, health, price competitiveness, infrastructure, and natural resources.

name: Visa-Free Destinations Accessible
description: Number of global destination jurisdictions citizen passport holders can enter without obtaining a consular visa.
methodology: Global aviation database cross-verification of international immigration border requirements.

name: Total Primary Energy Production
description: Gross extraction and generation of primary energy commodities within national territory in Terawatt-hours.
methodology: Physical energy accounting across solid fossil fuels, crude oil, natural gas, nuclear, and renewables.

name: Electric Power Consumption Per Capita
description: Total electricity generated by power plants less transmission, distribution, and transformation losses, divided by population.
methodology: Net national grid consumption divided by mid-year population in kilowatt-hours.

name: Gross Electricity Generation
description: Total electricity generated by all utility, commercial, and autoproducer power stations in Terawatt-hours.
methodology: Annual power plant generation statistics submitted to the International Energy Agency.

name: Renewable Energy Share in Power
description: Share of electricity generated from renewable sources (hydro, solar, wind, bioenergy, geothermal).
methodology: Renewable generation divided by total gross electricity generation multiplied by 100.

name: Solar Power Generation
description: Total electricity produced from utility-scale photovoltaic, rooftop solar, and concentrated solar power (CSP) facilities.
methodology: Net meter generation filings and national transmission system operator feeds.

name: Wind Energy Generation
description: Total electricity generated by onshore and offshore wind turbines in Terawatt-hours.
methodology: Grid operator transmission data calibrated with installed capacity capacity-factor modeling.

name: Hydroelectric Generation
description: Electricity generated from conventional hydroelectric dams, run-of-river installations, and pumped storage facilities.
methodology: Utility generation logs compiled under standard IEA energy statistics procedures.

name: Nuclear Power Generation
description: Total net electrical energy generated by commercial nuclear power reactor units.
methodology: IAEA official logged net electrical output reports from licensed operating civilian reactors.

name: Coal Share in Electricity
description: Percentage of total domestic electricity generation produced from anthracite, bituminous, sub-bituminous, and lignite coal.
methodology: Thermal coal generation divided by gross national power generation.

name: Crude Oil Production
description: Average daily extraction of crude oil, lease condensate, and natural gas plant liquids.
methodology: Wellhead meter production reports verified by petroleum ministry customs export audits.

name: Natural Gas Production
description: Gross volume of dry marketable natural gas produced from onshore and offshore reservoirs excluding flared gas.
methodology: Standard volumetric measurement at standard temperature (15°C) and pressure (101.325 kPa).

name: Electricity Access Rate
description: Percentage of people with access to electricity from utility grids or quality decentralized solar systems.
methodology: Multilevel logistic regression combining national electrification household surveys and grid connection databases.

name: Energy Intensity of Economy
description: Ratio of total primary energy supply (in megajoules) to gross domestic product in constant 2017 PPP dollars.
methodology: Energy consumed divided by economic output: lower values signify greater macroeconomic energy efficiency.

name: Low-Carbon Clean Power Share
description: Total percentage of domestic electricity produced from low-carbon sources (renewables plus civilian nuclear power).
methodology: Sum of hydro, solar, wind, nuclear, bioenergy, and geothermal generation divided by total generation.

name: Energy Transition Index (ETI)
description: Composite index evaluating energy system performance across environmental sustainability, energy security, and transition readiness.
methodology: 46 indicators evaluating current system performance and the enabling environment for clean energy transformation.

name: Crop Production Index
description: Relative agricultural crop output index based on constant international commodity prices.
methodology: Laspeyres index weighting national physical crop tonnages by international producer prices.

name: Cereal Yield
description: Harvested production of dry grain cereals (wheat, rice, maize, barley) per unit of harvested land area.
methodology: Reported national grain harvest weights divided by total harvested crop area in hectares.

name: Livestock Production Index
description: Relative volume of livestock products including meat, milk, eggs, and wool.
methodology: Physical production quantities weighted by international average livestock commodity farm-gate prices.

name: Total Fisheries & Aquaculture Output
description: Total annual live-weight volume of marine and inland capture fisheries plus commercial aquaculture production.
methodology: National port landing declarations and commercial fish farm harvest logs.

name: Agricultural Land Share
description: Share of national land area that is arable, under permanent crops, or under permanent pastures.
methodology: Land use census surveys compiled under the World Programme for the Census of Agriculture.

name: Agricultural Land Equipped for Irrigation
description: Area equipped with infrastructure to provide water to crops through surface, sprinkler, or localized drip irrigation.
methodology: Agricultural engineering census of operating pump, canal, and sprinkler networks.

name: Certified Organic Farmland Share
description: Percentage of agricultural land managed under certified organic farming principles without synthetic agrochemicals.
methodology: Accredited certification body registries (IFOAM, USDA Organic, EU Organic).

name: Undernourishment Prevalence
description: Percentage of national population facing chronic food deprivation and unable to meet minimum dietary energy requirements.
methodology: Probability of inadequate dietary intake estimated from national food balance sheets and consumption surveys.

name: Food Consumer Price Inflation
sourceName: FAO Food Price Index / World Bank
description: Annual percentage change in the consumer price index sub-basket specifically for food and non-alcoholic beverages.
methodology: Consumer retail food price sampling across urban and rural markets over 12 months.

name: Fertilizer Consumption Rate
description: Quantity of plant nutrients used per unit of arable land: nitrogen (N), phosphate (P2O5), and potash (K2O).
methodology: Domestic fertilizer production plus imports minus exports divided by arable land area.

name: Pesticide Application Rate
description: Total active ingredients of chemical plant protection products (insecticides, herbicides, fungicides) applied per hectare of cropland.
methodology: Commercial agricultural pesticide sales and import registries divided by cropland area.

name: Agricultural Mechanization Density
description: Number of agricultural wheel and crawler tractors utilized in farming per 100 square kilometers of arable land.
methodology: Agricultural machinery census audits and commercial equipment registration logs.

name: Agricultural Product Exports
description: Total value of exports of agricultural commodities and processed foodstuffs.
methodology: Standard International Trade Classification (SITC Section 0, 1, 22, 4) customs values in USD.

name: Household Food Waste Per Capita
description: Average quantity of edible and associated inedible parts of food discarded at the household consumer level.
methodology: Direct waste compositional compositional audits and household diary tracking surveys.

name: Electoral Democracy Rating
description: Metric gauging the institutional durability of the sovereign governance system and regular free, fair elections.
methodology: Multi-indicator assessment of electoral pluralism, checks and balances, and universal franchise.

name: Political Stability & Absence of Violence
description: Perceptions of the likelihood that the government will be destabilized or overthrown by unconstitutional or violent means.
methodology: Unobserved Components Model (UCM) aggregating cross-country surveys from expert rating agencies.

name: Women in National Parliament
description: Percentage of parliamentary seats in lower and single legislative chambers held by women.
methodology: Official parliamentary election gazettes compiled monthly by the Inter-Parliamentary Union.

name: Voter Turnout Rate
description: Total number of valid and invalid votes cast divided by the total number of registered voters in the latest national election.
methodology: Official election commission certified vote tallies.

name: Party Institutionalization Index
description: Level of organizational institutionalization, cohesion, and programmatic coherence of national political parties.
methodology: Varieties of Democracy (V-Dem) expert coding and Bayesian measurement modeling.

name: Current Constitution Lifespan
description: Number of continuous years the current national written constitution has remained legally in force.
methodology: Constitutional text analysis tracking formal promulgation dates and structural overhauls.

name: Democracy Index Score
description: Overall democracy classification benchmarking pluralism, civil liberties, and government functioning.
methodology: 60 indicators assessing 5 categories with final regime classification.

name: Government Effectiveness Index
description: Perceptions of the quality of public services, the quality of civil service and its independence from political pressures.
methodology: Constructed from 31 individual data sources measuring public sector management capacity.

name: Corruption Perceptions Index
description: Perceived degree of public sector corruption as evaluated by experts and business leaders.
methodology: Statistical standardization of composite corruption assessments onto a 0-100 scale.

name: Physical Integrity Rights Score
description: Degree to which individuals are free from government torture, extrajudicial execution, political imprisonment, and disappearance.
methodology: Bayesian latent trait model of human rights reports from the UN, Amnesty International, and US State Department.

name: Civil Liberties Index
description: Assessment of freedom of expression and belief, associational and organizational rights, rule of law, and personal autonomy.
methodology: Expert ratings on a 15-question civil liberties checklist scored 0 to 4 points each.

name: Multilateral UN Treaties Ratified
description: Total number of core multilateral treaties, conventions, and optional protocols deposited with the UN Secretary-General ratified.
methodology: Official UNTC legal registry of instruments of ratification, accession, and succession.

name: Global Diplomatic Network Size
description: Total count of embassies, high commissions, permanent missions, consulates-general, and consulates maintained abroad.
methodology: Foreign ministry official directory verification of accredited overseas diplomatic missions.

name: Global Peace Index Score
description: Relative peacefulness score evaluating internal peace, external peace, and national security.
methodology: Composite index combining 23 indicators of internal security and international militarisation.

name: Road Network Density
description: Total length of paved and unpaved motorable road networks per 100 square kilometers of sovereign land area.
methodology: National ministry of transport road asset registries divided by territorial land area.

name: Operating Railway Network Length
description: Total length of operating railway lines open for public freight and passenger transport.
methodology: UIC route kilometer audits excluding urban light rail and metro transit lines.

name: Airports with Paved Runways
description: Total number of civil, commercial, and military airports equipped with permanent concrete or asphalt paved runways.
methodology: Aeronautical Information Publications (AIP) and international civil aviation registries.

name: Container Port Throughput
description: Total maritime container traffic handled at national seaports expressed in Twenty-foot Equivalent Units (TEU).
methodology: Port authority manifests counting standard full and empty ISO intermodal freight containers.

name: Longest Bridge Span
description: Length of the longest structural bridge span or continuous viaduct in the national highway/railway system.
methodology: Structural engineering blueprints and national highway administration records.

name: Registered Large Dams
description: Total number of major dams with a height of 15 meters or greater from foundation to crest.
methodology: ICOLD World Register of Dams statutory water resource audits.

name: Electrification Rate
description: Percentage of the national resident population with an active connection to an electrical power network.
methodology: Multilevel survey modeling and utility customer meter database verification.

name: Mobile Base Station Density
description: Number of commercial cellular transceiver base stations and small cells per 10,000 residents.
methodology: Regulatory filings from mobile network operators (MNOs) with spectrum licenses.

name: Piped Water Infrastructure Access
description: Percentage of the population with direct piped drinking water access inside dwelling, plot or yard.
methodology: Water utility household connection databases combined with national population censuses.

name: Fixed Broadband Infrastructure
description: Active physical fixed-line broadband internet connections (cable, optical fiber, DSL) per 100 people.
methodology: Operator subscriber reports certified by national telecommunication regulators.

name: Logistics Performance Index (LPI)
description: Overall score assessing national trade logistics efficiency across customs, infrastructure, international shipments, competence, tracking, and timeliness.
methodology: Global survey of international freight forwarders and logistics professionals.

name: Urban Agglomeration Index
description: Level of physical urban built environment development and resident concentration in urban centers.
methodology: Degree of Urbanization (DEGURBA) methodology based on high-density 1 km² grid cells.

name: Construction Sector GDP Contribution
description: Gross value added by the civil construction and building engineering sector as a percentage of GDP.
methodology: SNA 2008 national accounts industrial classification (ISIC Rev. 4 Section F).

name: Housing Overcrowding Rate
description: Percentage of households living in overcrowded dwellings that do not have a minimum number of rooms relative to household size.
methodology: Household living conditions surveys based on bedroom-to-occupant ratio standards.

name: Transport Infrastructure Investment
description: Total public and private capital investment in roads, railways, inland waterways, maritime ports, and airports as a percentage of GDP.
methodology: Capital expenditure on transport assets excluding routine operating and maintenance costs.

name: Mean Annual Surface Temperature
description: Nationwide land-surface air temperature averaged across all 12 calendar months.
methodology: Spatially kriged surface meteorological station network records calibrated against satellite radiometers.

name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
description: Departure of annual mean national temperature relative to the 1951-1980 climatological baseline period.
methodology: Differential gridded anomaly mapping showing localized climatic warming deviations.

name: Average Annual Precipitation
sourceName: World Bank Climate Knowledge Portal / GPCC
description: Total depth of liquid and equivalent frozen precipitation falling on national territory annually.
methodology: Global Precipitation Climatology Centre (GPCC) rain-gauge network spatial interpolation.

name: Seasonal Snow Cover Extent
description: Average proportion of national land area covered by seasonal winter snowpack.
methodology: Visible and infrared satellite radiometer binary snow cover mapping.

name: Drought Severity Index
description: Combined Drought Indicator evaluating precipitation deficits, soil moisture anomalies, and vegetation stress.
methodology: Satellite soil moisture (SMAP) and Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) anomaly integration.

name: Population in High Flood Risk Zones
sourceName: World Bank Global Flood Risk Database 2024
description: Percentage of resident population residing in 1-in-100-year riverine and coastal flood inundation hazard zones.
methodology: Global hydrodynamic flood modeling overlaid on high-resolution population distribution layers.

name: Tropical Cyclone Hazard Index
description: Decadal frequency of Category 1-5 tropical cyclones, hurricanes, and typhoons making landfall.
methodology: International Best Track Archive for Climate Stewardship (IBTrACS) post-storm satellite reanalyses.

name: Extreme Weather Disasters Recorded
description: Annual recorded catastrophic weather events meeting EM-DAT disaster criteria (10+ deaths, 100+ affected, state of emergency).
methodology: Verified multi-source tracking of catastrophic droughts, extreme temperatures, storms, and floods.

name: Relative Coastal Sea Level Rise Rate
sourceName: NASA Sea Level Change Team / PSMSL 2024
description: Local rate of coastal sea level rise factoring global thermal expansion, ice sheet melt, and vertical land motion.
methodology: Dual-frequency satellite altimetry (TOPEX/Poseidon, Jason, Sentinel-6) and coastal tide gauges.

name: Glacier Mass Balance Trend
description: Annual net balance of national mountain glaciers and ice caps in meters of water equivalent.
methodology: In situ glaciological stake measurements combined with geodetic satellite stereo-imagery DEM differencing.

name: Territorial Arctic/Antarctic Ice Cover
description: Area of territorial polar sea ice and ice sheets with at least 15% ice concentration.
methodology: Passive microwave satellite sensors (SSMIS, AMSR2) processing polar brightness temperatures.

name: Total Annual GHG Emissions
description: Total national greenhouse gas emissions (CO₂, CH₄, N₂O, F-gases) excluding land-use change and forestry.
methodology: IPCC 100-year Global Warming Potential (GWP-100) metric converting gases to CO₂ equivalents.

name: ND-GAIN Climate Vulnerability Score
description: Composite index evaluating country vulnerability to climate disruption across food, water, health, ecosystem, habitat, and infrastructure.
methodology: 36 indicators measuring exposure, sensitivity, and adaptive capacity to negative climate impacts.

name: Projected 2050 Temperature Increase
sourceName: IPCC Sixth Assessment Report (SSP2-4.5) / World Bank
description: Projected mean annual surface temperature increase by 2050 relative to 1986-2005 under middle-of-the-road emissions.
methodology: CMIP6 multi-model ensemble median projections downscaled to national administrative boundaries.

name: Total Labor Force
description: Total resident population aged 15 and older who supply labor for the production of goods and services (employed and unemployed).
methodology: National labor force surveys adhering to ILO resolution concerning statistics of work, employment and labor underutilization.

name: Employment-to-Population Ratio
description: Proportion of a country's working-age population that is employed.
methodology: Total employed persons divided by total working-age population aged 15 and over.

name: Total Unemployment Rate
description: Share of the labor force that is without work but available for and seeking employment.
methodology: Unemployed persons actively seeking employment divided by total active civilian labor force.

name: Youth Unemployment Rate
description: Proportion of the labor force aged 15-24 that is without work but available for and seeking employment.
methodology: Youth unemployed divided by youth labor force cohort under standardized ILO survey criteria.

name: Statutory Monthly Minimum Wage
description: Legally mandated minimum monthly gross remuneration payable by an employer to wage earners.
methodology: Official statutory legislation converted to current US dollars using market exchange rates.

name: Average Weekly Working Hours
description: Average actual hours worked per week per employed person in main job.
methodology: National labor force survey recall of actual hours worked during reference week.

name: Labor Force Participation Rate
description: Percentage of the working-age population aged 15 and older that engages actively in the labor market.
methodology: Total labor force (employed + unemployed) divided by total resident population aged 15+.

name: Labor Participation Gender Gap
description: Difference in percentage points between the male and female labor force participation rates.
methodology: Male labor force participation rate minus female labor force participation rate.

name: Services Sector Employment Share
description: Share of employed individuals working in tertiary service sector industries (commerce, finance, transport, healthcare, education).
methodology: ISIC Rev. 4 industrial classifications (Sections G through U) divided by total employment.

name: Informal Employment Rate
sourceName: ILO Women and Men in the Informal Economy 2024
description: Percentage of non-agricultural employment consisting of jobs that lack social security, labor rights, and legal protection.
methodology: 17th ICLS statistical definitions of informal employment based on employment relationships and enterprise registration.

name: Migrant Workers in Labor Force
sourceName: ILO Global Estimates on International Migrant Workers
description: Share of the domestic civilian labor force who are international foreign-born migrant workers.
methodology: National population censuses and residence permit registries tracking foreign-born active employment.

name: Labor Productivity (GDP / Worker)
description: Gross domestic product divided by the total number of employed persons in the economy.
methodology: Constant 2017 PPP GDP divided by total employment headcount: key metric of macroeconomic output efficiency.

name: Fatal Work Injury Rate
description: Annual number of fatal occupational injuries occurring among workers per 100,000 employed people.
methodology: National occupational health and safety labor inspection records and social security compensation claims.

name: Social Protection Effective Coverage
description: Proportion of population effectively covered by at least one social protection cash benefit.
methodology: Social Security Inquiry (SSI) administrative beneficiary records mapped to demographic cohorts.

name: Child Labor Prevalence
description: Percentage of children aged 5-17 engaged in economic work exceeding age-specific threshold hours or hazardous labor.
methodology: Multiple Indicator Cluster Surveys (MICS) and Demographic and Health Surveys (DHS) child labor modules.

name: Gross R&D Expenditure (GERD)
description: Total domestic expenditure on scientific research and experimental development in billion current PPP dollars.
methodology: Frascati Manual OECD surveys covering industry, university, and public sector research spending.

name: R&D Researchers Density
description: Professionals engaged in the conception or creation of new knowledge, products, and processes per million residents.
methodology: Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) headcount of scientists and research engineers active in R&D.

name: Scientific Journal Articles Published
description: Peer-reviewed scientific and technical articles published in major scholarly journals indexed by Scopus and Web of Science.
methodology: Fractional count of articles across physics, chemistry, biology, mathematics, medicine, engineering, and geosciences.

name: Mean Scientific Citations Per Paper
description: Average number of citations received per published scientific citable document over a 3-year window.
methodology: Citation tracking within the Elsevier Scopus bibliographic database.

name: Triadic Patent Families
description: Set of patents filed at the European Patent Office (EPO), Japan Patent Office (JPO), and US Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO) for the same invention.
methodology: Indicator of highest-value global technological inventions eliminating national filing home-court bias.

name: Civilian Space Agency Budget
description: Annual government appropriations for national civilian space programs and space exploration agencies.
methodology: National legislative budget appropriations for space research, satellite launch, and planetary exploration.

name: Operational Satellites in Orbit
sourceName: Union of Concerned Scientists (UCS) Satellite Database
description: Number of active, functioning satellites registered to sovereign commercial, government, or military operators in Earth orbit.
methodology: Regular satellite orbital tracking verified through UN Space Register and US Space Command data.

name: Major Astronomical Observatories
description: Number of major optical and radio telescope research facilities with apertures exceeding 2.0 meters.
methodology: IAU registry of world professional astronomical observatories.

name: Biotechnology Patents Share
description: Percentage of international patent applications dedicated to genetic engineering, pharmaceuticals, and cellular biology.
methodology: WIPO International Patent Classification (IPC) codes targeting biotechnology and medical technology.

name: Registered Clinical Trials
description: Total number of registered clinical trial investigations for medical therapeutics, biologics, and pharmaceuticals.
methodology: WHO Primary Registries (ClinicalTrials.gov, EU Clinical Trials Register, national clinical registries).

name: Physical Sciences Research Output
description: High-impact research articles published in premier physical chemistry, quantum, and high-energy physics journals.
methodology: Share metric of articles published in 82 natural science journals selected by independent scientific panels.

name: Engineering Graduate Share
description: Percentage of tertiary education degrees awarded in engineering, manufacturing, and construction disciplines.
methodology: ISCED-F 2013 broad field 07 (Engineering, manufacturing and construction) graduate count.

name: Nobel Prize Laureates Total
description: Total number of Nobel Prizes awarded to individuals and organizations associated with the country by nationality or affiliation.
methodology: Official records of the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences, Karolinska Institute, and Norwegian Nobel Committee.

name: TOP500 Supercomputers Hosted
description: Number of high-performance supercomputers ranked on the official biannual TOP500 list based on Linpack benchmark.
methodology: High Performance Linpack (HPL) benchmark measured in petaflops (Rmax).

name: International Co-Authorship Rate
description: Percentage of published scientific papers produced with at least one institutional co-author in a different country.
methodology: Bibliometric institutional affiliation cross-referencing on multiauthored publications.

name: All-Time Olympic Medals Total
description: Total cumulative Olympic gold, silver, and bronze medals won across all modern Summer and Winter Olympic Games.
methodology: Official historical medal databases of the International Olympic Committee.

name: All-Time Paralympic Medals Total
description: Total medals won at Summer and Winter Paralympic Games by the National Paralympic Committee.
methodology: Official IPC historical tournament medal databases.

name: FIFA Men's World Ranking
description: Official global ranking position of men's national association football teams.
methodology: Elo-based point algorithm weighting match results, importance, and relative team strength over international fixtures.

name: ICC Men's Cricket World Ranking
description: Official global ranking position of national men's cricket teams across Test, ODI, and T20 international formats.
methodology: Match points divided by total matches played weighted over a 3-year performance window.

name: FIBA Men's Basketball Ranking
description: Official global ranking of men's national basketball teams in official FIBA tournaments and qualifiers.
methodology: Game result point algorithm factoring margin of victory, home/away status, and opponent strength over 8 years.

name: Top 100 Professional Tennis Players
description: Total professional tennis players representing the country ranked in the official ATP (men) and WTA (women) singles top 100.
methodology: Rolling 52-week ATP and WTA ranking point leaderboards.

name: Top 50 Badminton World Players
description: Number of athletes ranked in the BWF singles and doubles world top 50.
methodology: BWF World Ranking tournament point accumulation across Super 1000, 750, and 500 events.

name: FIH Field Hockey World Ranking
description: Official global ranking position of national men's and women's field hockey teams.
methodology: Match-based world ranking system calculating points from certified international hockey fixtures.

name: World Athletics Records Held
description: Total recognized current world records in track and field, road running, and race walking events held by national athletes.
methodology: World Athletics certified and ratifying timing and anti-doping verification.

name: World Aquatics Championship Medals
description: Cumulative medals won across all World Aquatics Championships in swimming, diving, and water polo.
methodology: Official World Aquatics competitive championship medal registers.

name: Olympic Sports Diversity Index
sourceName: IOC / Association of Summer Olympic IFs
description: Number of distinct Olympic disciplines in which the national Olympic committee has won at least one medal.
methodology: Cross-disciplinary medal verification across all IOC-sanctioned Olympic sports.

name: Guinness World Records Recognized
description: Total officially ratified athletic and sporting Guinness World Records currently held.
methodology: Certified adjudicator measurements and anti-doping clearances.

name: Adult Physical Activity Compliance
description: Percentage of adult population meeting WHO recommendations of at least 150 minutes of moderate-intensity physical activity per week.
methodology: Global Physical Activity Questionnaire (GPAQ) and International Physical Activity Questionnaire (IPAQ) surveys.

name: Major Stadiums (>30k Capacity)
sourceName: World Stadiums Database / FIFA Venue Registries
description: Number of multipurpose, football, cricket, and athletic stadiums with permanent seating capacity exceeding 30,000 spectators.
methodology: Certified architectural seating plan inspections and sports federations tournament licensing.

name: Senior World Cup Championship Titles
sourceName: FIFA / ICC / World Rugby Official Records
description: Total championship titles won at premier global senior tournaments in football, cricket, and rugby union.
methodology: Official historical tournament tournament winners logs.

name: Largest Metro Population
description: Total population residing in the single largest contiguous urban agglomeration or metropolitan area in the country.
methodology: Demographia continuous urban footprint satellite night-light and census enumeration.

name: Annual Urban Population Growth Rate
description: Annual average rate of change of the size of the total national urban population.
methodology: Annualized log difference between consecutive urban population estimates.

name: Largest Urban Area Density
description: Human population density per square kilometer within the continuously built-up urban area of the largest city.
methodology: Built-up urban footprint area divided into the contiguous resident population.

name: Largest City Metropolitan GDP
sourceName: Brookings Global Metro Monitor / Oxford Economics 2024
description: Gross domestic product generated specifically within the metropolitan economic region of the primate city.
methodology: Regional economic accounting and subnational input-output tables converted to current US dollars.

name: Primate City Cost of Living Index
description: Comparative price level index for consumer goods and services in the primary commercial city benchmarked against New York City.
methodology: Sampling of over 200 consumer items including housing, food, transport, clothing, and entertainment.

name: Urban Quality of Living Score
sourceName: Mercer Quality of Living / EIU Global Liveability 2024
description: City-level liveability score assessing political stability, crime, economic environment, healthcare, education, and recreation.
methodology: 39 factors evaluated for multinational expatriates and resident urban populations.

name: IMD Smart City Index Score
description: Evaluation of how technology and digital solutions improve the daily lives of citizens in urban areas.
methodology: Citizen perceptions of smart infrastructure across health, mobility, activities, opportunities, and governance.

name: Capital City PM2.5 Exposure
description: Annual average concentration of particulate matter under 2.5 microns in the national capital city.
methodology: Official municipal environmental agency continuous monitoring stations.

name: Urban Green Space Per Resident
description: Public parks, gardens, recreational grounds, and urban canopy area per resident in the primary city.
methodology: High-resolution satellite Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) masked by municipal park polygons.

name: Public Transit Commuter Share
description: Proportion of daily work and education trips completed on metro, bus, tram, and suburban rail networks in the primary city.
methodology: Comprehensive municipal origin-destination transport surveys.

name: Urban House Price-to-Income Ratio
description: Median house price in the primary city divided by median annual gross household income.
methodology: Standard international housing affordability index (under 3.0 is affordable; 5.1+ is severely unaffordable).

name: Urban Safety & Security Index
sourceName: EIU Safe Cities Index / Numbeo Crime Index 2024
description: Metric evaluating personal, digital, health, infrastructure, and environmental security in the primary city.
methodology: 76 quantitative and qualitative security indicators.

name: Top City International Tourist Arrivals
description: Total annual international overnight visitors arriving and staying in the country's most visited destination city.
methodology: Commercial credit card cross-border transaction volumes cross-checked with flight manifests.

name: Skyscrapers Over 150m Built
sourceName: Council on Tall Buildings and Urban Habitat (CTBUH 2024)
description: Total number of completed architectural tall buildings reaching or exceeding 150 meters (492 feet) in height.
methodology: CTBUH Skyscraper Center engineering field inspections and architectural height certifications.

name: National Urbanization Level
description: Total percentage of sovereign population living in cities and designated urban areas.
methodology: National statistical office criteria applied to census enumerations.

name: SDG 1: No Poverty Score
description: Progress score on eliminating poverty: poverty headcount ratio at $2.15/day, national poverty line, and multidimensional poverty.
methodology: Normalized score where 100 indicates complete achievement of SDG 1 targets under official UN metadata.

name: SDG 2: Zero Hunger Score
description: Progress on ending hunger, achieving food security, improving nutrition, and promoting sustainable agriculture.
methodology: Composite of undernourishment prevalence, child stunting, cereal yield, and sustainable nitrogen management.

name: SDG 3: Good Health & Well-being
description: Progress on ensuring healthy lives and promoting well-being for all at all ages.
methodology: Composite of maternal mortality, neonatal mortality, road traffic deaths, universal health coverage, and life expectancy.

name: SDG 4: Quality Education Score
description: Progress on ensuring inclusive and equitable quality education and promoting lifelong learning opportunities for all.
methodology: Composite of primary completion rate, lower secondary completion rate, and literacy rates.

name: SDG 5: Gender Equality Score
description: Progress on achieving gender equality and empowering all women and girls.
methodology: Composite of female labor force participation, parliamentary representation, and gender wage differentials.

name: SDG 6: Clean Water & Sanitation
description: Progress on ensuring availability and sustainable management of water and sanitation for all.
methodology: Composite of access to safely managed drinking water, sanitation services, and freshwater stress.

name: SDG 7: Affordable & Clean Energy
description: Progress on ensuring access to affordable, reliable, sustainable and modern energy for all.
methodology: Composite of electrification rate, clean cooking fuels access, and renewable energy share.

name: SDG 8: Decent Work & Economic Growth
description: Progress on sustained, inclusive and sustainable economic growth, full and productive employment.
methodology: Composite of real GDP per capita growth, fatal work injury rate, and youth NEET rate (not in employment, education, or training).

name: SDG 9: Industry, Innovation & Infra
description: Progress on building resilient infrastructure, promoting inclusive and sustainable industrialization and fostering innovation.
methodology: Composite of rural road accessibility, mobile broadband subscriptions, R&D expenditure, and scientific publications.

name: SDG 10: Reduced Inequalities Score
description: Progress on reducing income inequality within and among countries.
methodology: Composite of Gini coefficient, Palma ratio (richest 10% share to poorest 40% share), and social protection coverage.

name: SDG 11: Sustainable Cities Score
description: Progress on making cities and human settlements inclusive, safe, resilient, and sustainable.
methodology: Composite of urban PM2.5 pollution exposure, access to public transport, and municipal solid waste collection rates.

name: SDG 12: Responsible Consumption
description: Progress on ensuring sustainable consumption and production patterns.
methodology: Composite of municipal solid waste generation, electronic waste recycled, and production-based nitrogen emissions.

name: SDG 13: Climate Action Score
description: Progress on taking urgent action to combat climate change and its impacts.
methodology: Composite of fossil fuel CO2 emissions per capita, imported CO2 emissions, and climate vulnerability.

name: SDG 14: Life Below Water Score
description: Progress on conserving and sustainably using the oceans, seas and marine resources for sustainable development.
methodology: Composite of mean marine protected area coverage, clean waters index, and fish caught by bottom trawling.

name: SDG 15: Life on Land Score
description: Progress on protecting, restoring and promoting sustainable use of terrestrial ecosystems, sustainably managing forests, combating desertification.
methodology: Composite of terrestrial Key Biodiversity Areas protected, Red List Index, and annual forest cover change.

name: SDG 16: Peace, Justice & Institutions
description: Progress on promoting peaceful and inclusive societies for sustainable development, providing access to justice for all.
methodology: Composite of homicide rate, unsentenced detainees share, Corruption Perceptions Index, and press freedom.

name: SDG 17: Partnerships for the Goals
description: Progress on strengthening the means of implementation and revitalizing the Global Partnership for Sustainable Development.
methodology: Composite of official development assistance (ODA) as % of GNI, government revenue as % of GDP, and statistical performance index.
